sloka: तेन शब्देन महता प्रत्यबुध्यत वानरः ।मद विह्वल ताम्राक्षो व्याकुल स्रग्वि भूषणः ॥४-३१-४१॥
transliteration: tena śabdena mahatā pratyabudhyata vānaraḥ ।mada vihvala tāmrākṣo vyākula sragvi bhūṣaṇaḥ ॥4-31-41॥

translations.english: By the great sound (of the monkeys) the drunken redeyed vanara king awakened, his garlands and ornaments in disarray.
